The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
seeks to assail the award dated 31.01.2023 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal.

2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned Tribunal has failed to appreciate that it was a clear case of composite negligence and therefore, respondent nos.5 and 6 also ought to have been directed to pay compensation.

3. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
4.
In the meanwhile, let the TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
5. List alongwith MAC.APP.335/2018 on 28.08.2023.

7. Taking into account that even if the appellant succeeds in the appeal, only the quantum of compensation will be reduced, the application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit,
within six weeks, 75% of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of the claimants as per the scheme of disbursal as contained in the impugned award.
8.
Subject to the appellant depositing the amount in terms of this order, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal.
9. The application stands disposed of.
